name: Woodland Hills
title: Window Treatments in Woodland Hills | John Crawford
description: Compare custom blinds, shades, shutters and drapery at John Crawford Company's Woodland Hills showroom, or arrange a free in-home consultation.
heading: Custom window treatments in Woodland Hills
intro: Arrange a visit to our Woodland Hills showroom on Ventura Boulevard to compare fabrics and finishes in person. We’re happy to help with one window or a whole home.

hero_image.alt: John Crawford standing outside the Woodland Hills showroom and pointing to the John Crawford Company sign.
hero_image.caption: John outside our showroom at 22311 Ventura Blvd #101.

introduction.heading: See the choices in person.
paragraphs: It’s easier to compare colors and textures when you can see them in person. At the showroom, we can look at shutter finishes, shade fabrics and drapery samples together.

John started with installation, and that experience still shapes the advice we give. We consider how a treatment fits the window, how much of the view you’ll have when it’s open and which controls you prefer.

products_intro: We carry Hunter Douglas and Alta window treatments. Start with the look you like, then compare the fabrics, materials and controls available for your windows.

products.title: Shades
products.text: Compare roller, honeycomb, Roman, woven wood and sheer shades for daylight, privacy and texture.

products.title: Shutters
products.text: Compare wood, composite and vinyl shutters to find a finish and style you like.

products.title: Blinds
products.text: Explore wood, faux wood and metal blinds, along with vertical options for broad windows and doors.

products.title: Drapery
products.text: Explore fabrics and hardware for custom drapery, on its own or layered with a shade.

products.title: Motorized shades
products.text: Learn about motorized shade options and how we handle installation and setup.

visit.heading: Prefer to compare samples at home?
paragraphs: We also offer free in-home consultations in Woodland Hills and Warner Center. Seeing samples in your room makes it easier to compare colors and see how the fabric changes the light.
We’ll bring samples, talk through your ideas and budget, and take measurements during the visit.

steps.title: Compare the options
steps.text: We’ll look at the light, privacy and appearance you want in each room.

steps.title: Check the fit
steps.text: We check the size and shape of the windows so we can recommend options that fit well.

steps.title: Help with the controls
steps.text: We can explain the control options and show you how they work, including motorization where available.

questions_heading: Planning a visit or a project

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment for the showroom?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Woodland Hills showroom is open by appointment, Monday–Saturday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Call or use the contact form to request a showroom visit, and we’ll arrange a time with you.

faqs.question: Can you help with just one window?
faqs.answer: Yes. John has always welcomed single-window projects. You can come to us for one blind, a room you’re updating or window treatments for a whole home.

faqs.question: What if I need a blind or shade repaired?
faqs.answer: We review the product, its condition and the parts available to see whether a repair is possible. The repair request form lets you describe the problem and attach photos.

contact_heading: Let’s talk about your Woodland Hills home.
contact_text: Choose a showroom visit or a free in-home consultation. We’ll help you find a starting point, even if you’re still deciding what you like.

name: Bell Canyon
title: Window Treatments in Bell Canyon | John Crawford Company
description: Explore custom shades, shutters, blinds and drapery for your Bell Canyon home. Request a free in-home consultation with John Crawford Company.
heading: Custom window treatments in Bell Canyon
intro: Explore custom shades, shutters, blinds and drapery for your Bell Canyon home. We offer free in-home consultations so you can see samples in your own space and get help choosing.

hero_image.alt: Pale Roman shades partly lowered over broad garden-facing windows behind a curved sofa.
hero_image.caption: Hunter Douglas Vignette® Modern Roman Shades

introduction.heading: Start with the rooms you use every day.
paragraphs: Maybe the afternoon sun hits your seating area, or you’d like more privacy in a bedroom. If keeping the view is important, we can talk through that, too.
We’ll bring samples and take measurements during the home visit. You can hold fabrics up to the window, see how much light comes through and talk with us about the look you have in mind.

link.text: What to expect from an in-home consultation

products_heading: Find the treatment that suits the room
products_intro: Our range includes Hunter Douglas and Alta window treatments. You can coordinate the colors and fabrics across your home while choosing different treatments for different openings.

products.title: Shades
products.text: Compare light-filtering and room-darkening fabrics, along with woven textures and Roman folds.

products.title: Shutters
products.text: Compare wood, composite and vinyl shutters, and see how the colors look with your window trim.

products.title: Blinds
products.text: Compare wood, faux wood and metal blinds, plus vertical options for wide windows and sliding doors.

products.title: Drapery
products.text: Compare fabric, lining and hardware for curtains that close across the window or panels that frame it.

products.title: Motorized shades
products.text: Find out how motorized shades work and which controls are available.

feature.heading: Adjust your shades from across the room.
paragraphs: For a high window or one behind furniture, motorization lets you adjust the shade without reaching the window. Hunter Douglas PowerView® Automation offers remote and app control for compatible shades.
We can explain how the shades are powered and help you choose controls you’ll be comfortable using. We also handle installation and setup, and show you how to use the system.

visit.heading: The fit deserves as much attention as the fabric.
paragraphs: We measure at several points across and down each window, then check how straight and level the opening is. This helps us recommend a treatment that fits well and works properly.
For wide windows and glass doors, we’ll also look at the view when the treatment is open and whether you can use the door comfortably.

link.text: Read about professional measuring and installation

guide.text: Our guide to window treatments for large windows

faqs.question: Do you have a showroom in Bell Canyon?
faqs.answer: Our showroom is in Woodland Hills, at 22311 Ventura Blvd #101. We serve Bell Canyon with free in-home consultations, and you’re also welcome to arrange a showroom appointment.

faqs.question: Do I need to know which product I want?
faqs.answer: You can start with a question or a few ideas about the room. We’ll help you explore the options, even if you haven’t settled on a style or product.

faqs.question: Can I replace some treatments and keep others?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can help with one window or several rooms. We can also help you choose new fabrics and finishes that work with the treatments you want to keep.

contact_heading: Plan a visit to your Bell Canyon home.
contact_text: Tell us which rooms you’re thinking about, or ask for a showroom appointment. We serve Bell Canyon from our Woodland Hills showroom.
